_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 9: Schedule It / Autonomy (GOAL 'Your AI Employee', the explainer that closes the whole series). 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each, left to right (rebuilt 2026-09-23). Arc: Pain (the AI Employee - weekly-email/, the lead skill running pull-stats/ -> what-worked/ -> draft-email/ -> qa-draft/ - works perfectly and you are still the start button) -> Earned (proven, hardened + passes its scorecard, harness: all built in CP4) -> Setup (four blanks: Monday 7:00am, stats/last-week.csv, drafts/weekly-email.md, how you get told) -> Line (it runs without you; it does not send without you) -> End state (it runs Monday, you read the result). Slide 05 is the series' closing image: the Monday timeline, then - in its own band below the 'HOW FAR YOU'VE COME' divider - the ladder in the exact words of v4-skill-system/05 (skill = a task -> skill system = a function -> AI Employee = owns the function and starts itself), now marked YOU ARE HERE on the top rung.
